scope: Final investor records for the frozen candidates that the human reviewer labelled eligible in data/reviews.json. Unit of record: the VC manager organization; funds are listed under capital, not as separate investors. Every fact names its own source items; facts not established from checked public sources have value null and an unavailableReason.
activeRule: activityStatus is active only when at least one completed direct investment has an eventDate between 2023-10-22 and the frozen datasetDate 2026-10-22 (36 months).
sourceCheckNote: userChecked is true only where data/candidates.json records the user's own manual check of that source. Other sources were opened and read with Claude Code (WebFetch) on the access date and support a candidate the user labelled eligible, but the individual field was not separately recorded as user-checked.
